finalText:
Found it: `computeTotal` in `src/services/pricing.js` was converting the subtotal to the target currency first, then subtracting the flat coupon as if it were already in that currency — even though coupons are stored in USD. A $10 coupon on a €90 total was coming off as €10, not €9.

The fix subtracts the flat coupon in USD before converting, so the discount gets converted along with the rest of the order. All 5 tests pass now.
